What Is an Online BCom Degree?
An online BCom degree is a 3-year undergraduate program designed to build a strong foundation in commerce subjects like accounting, economics, taxation, and finance.
Delivered through digital platforms, it allows students to learn at their own pace without compromising on quality or industry relevance.
The BCom online course at DSU goes a step further by offering in-demand specializations like Business Law to make students more versatile and job ready.

Course Structure & Curriculum Overview
The BCom degree distance learning format covers six semesters over three years. The Business Law specialization is woven into core commerce subjects.
Semester Highlights:

items: Sem 1–2: Financial Accounting, Microeconomics, Business Communication
Sem 3–4: Corporate Law, Marketing, Income Tax, Business Ethics
Sem 5–6: Advanced Company Law, IPR, Auditing, Final Project/Internship

FAQs
01. What is the duration of an online BCom degree?
It is a 3-year undergraduate program, typically structured over six semesters.
02. Are online BCom degrees recognized in India?
Yes. UGC-approved online BCom programs are fully valid for jobs, government exams, and higher education.
03. What is the average online BCom degree fees?
Fees range from ₹30,000 to ₹90,000 per year depending on the university and features included.
04. Can I pursue CA or LLB after online BCom?
Absolutely. An online BCom qualifies you to pursue CA, CS, LLB, MBA, and other postgraduate programs.
05. Is business law a good specialization for commerce students?
Yes. It enhances your understanding of legal and compliance aspects in business, vital for many high paying roles.
